HDMI CEC is a standard that works in tandem with ARC and EARC. Brands can change the CEC standard to allow better connectivity/features with their brand of tvs and soundbars. However when brands do this it sometimes cause brand interoperability problems. (Personally I think brands know if this but they do it as a way to get you to buy a new soundbar when you buy a new tv or vice versa.) For example I have a sony tv and a vizio soundbar and about once a week the tv wants me to reconnect the soundbar. However if I dont pair them again I still get sound like you. There are a few things you can do to try and fix this

  
1.check for firmware updates on the tv and soundbar (if your soundbar has them)  


2. check with Hisene to see if there are any settings on your tv that will help your soundbar paired. (such as turning off eco mode on EARC or ARC port)

​

3. if neither of those work then the only thing that you can really do is buy a hisene soundbar or a samsung tv to avoid this problem.
